purpose: Isolate question wording from fact order, then diagnose past assistant history before choosing one bounded intervention.
author: Project AI reviewer; no human-independent claim.

sourceVersion.meaning: Current e05b330 model source and evaluator/ORDERS head8b466cc; old PR outputs from b5fc677 remain historical, not same-version new outputs.

generation.runtime: Own ConversationEngine; no alternate reference weights or response templates.
generation.system: Same exact default system/context string in all new conditions; save its text/hash and Engine/source identities in each actual output.
generation.reset: Each single-turn factorial cell starts from an empty dialog history; each history episode/branch resets before USER1.
generation.technical: Record raw text and token IDs, EOS vs budget stop, promptTokens, discardedPromptTokens, errors and blocked turns. Keep truncated and wrong replies; no regeneration after seeing outcome.
generation.exclusion: Do not feed constraints, critical rules, requestedTarget, scoring, future USER or current/future ideal replies.

models.optionalOwnRaw: RAW1024 may be compared only after root separately registers exact native artifact and source/manifest/tokenizer/weights receipt before its new80 outputs; raw causal-language dose differs from C7. No automatic promotion.
models.prPointerV1Best: Weights ZIP not available locally; do not claim restoration or actual generation of that condition. Historical archived32-token evidence stays separate.
models.oldControlReuse: Do not repeat16TRAIN64 controls or previous8 wording probe. C7 old40 baseline may reuse the exact User/history/token/text equivalence receipt; no equality presumed for another artifact.

factorialDesign.construction: USER = exact factParagraph + two newline characters + exact question. o0 preserves block order; o1 reverses only complete independent blocks. w0 canonical question; w1 semantic paraphrase. All four cells have the same facts and target.
factorialDesign.wordingComparison: Compare w0 vsw1 separately within o0 and within o1: factParagraph UTF8 is byte identical.
factorialDesign.orderComparison: Compare o0 vso1 separately within w0 and within w1: question UTF8 is byte identical. Each original block is unchanged.
factorialDesign.targetBalance: r01/r02, r03/r04, r05/r06 and r07/r08 query each of two different entities against the same fact paragraph. A universal last-mentioned-entity shortcut cannot answer both targets correctly.
factorialDesign.limitations: These are newly authored formulations, not documented copies of TRAIN templates. Canonical means the plain phrasing of this probe, not known-to-training wording. Exact prompt isolation does not prove universal linguistic invariance.

historyDesign.sameUsers: Both branches use identical USER strings in identical order. Compare turns2–4 separately; turn1 has no previous assistant history and must be technically checked rather than assumed equal.
historyDesign.actual: Feed every prior USER and every own prior generated assistant reply verbatim. Archive complete stored/effective-history information. Only this branch is conversational evidence eligible for any acceptance interpretation.
historyDesign.ideal: For diagnostic turnk feed previous USER1..k and the fixed ideal-history.json replies1..k-1 as previous assistant messages. Archive newly generated replies but do not feed them into the following ideal-history prompt. Never feed current or future ideal reply.
historyDesign.expectationExposure: actual: no expectations fed. ideal: only explicitly declared past ideal assistant replies are fed as the intervention; constraints/rubric/current answer remain offline. The branch is aided diagnostic history, not unassisted conversation.
historyDesign.interpretation: Compare actual-vsideal CPF and criticals by exact episode/turn; stratify whether a preceding actual reply was C/P/F and contradicted facts. Differences may reflect factual cleanliness, style and history length together; they do not isolate a single cause or show memory loss on their own.
historyDesign.known40: No new ideal-history run over old40 is required by this compact probe.

CPF.C: Complete, relevant, intelligible, and satisfies every turn constraint; semantic equivalence is accepted. Exact text match is optional descriptive metadata.
CPF.P: Some correct useful response, but a requested part or instruction fails or remains omitted, while the reply is not globally irrelevant, inintelligible or factually incorrect.
CPF.F: Irrelevant, largely unintelligible, or makes an incorrect assertion about the given facts or requested relation; no meaningful useful answer.
CPF.critical: A concrete invented/contradictory identity, relationship, correction, known or explicitly unknown fact listed in criticalIf; also any severe explicit-instruction violation identified prospectively as critical. A critical reply cannot be C. Do not infer a critical proposition from omissions or broken fragments.
CPF.instructionSeverity: One extra true detail, multiple sentences, greeting or missing desired format prevents C but is not automatically critical. Inventing a forbidden missing hour/destination/fabricator or reversing a stated relation is critical.
CPF.perTurn: Write actual text, constraints, CPF, critical flag, exact evidence quote and brief reason. Preserve primary/cross disagreements.

rubric.B_linguistic: Use frozen intelligibility/grammar/cohesion0–3, predicative-unit and paragraph/repetition formulas from /workspace/ia-propia/private/conversation/simple-spanish-language-stage-v1/language-development-review-protocol.json SHA4406fe7014dd612b8cc0bcc7cfc450421af55e7bec6e2acac46b073e315207cf; B excludes factual correctness, relevance and requested format. Report by task and length band; no compound score, no pass from fluency.
rubric.semanticComponents: For each turn mark separately factual-content/relation success, instruction/clarification success and linguistic intelligibility; these descriptive tags do not replace CPF. A false fluent response can have good B and F in C.
rubric.episodes: Actual or ideal episode complete iff all four replies C and no critical; do not combine branches. Singles have no four-turn dialog completion metric.

comparisonMatrix.singleTurn: Per skill show n=16 cells; CPF and criticals by o/w cell, plus24 wording-pair transitions and24 order-pair transitions. Show C→P/F, P/F→C, unchanged, critical differences. Balanced entity contrasts are listed by world.
comparisonMatrix.multiTurn: Per episode and branch show16 actual and16 ideal CPF/criticals and dialogs0–4; separately first-turn4 and later-turn12 comparisons with prior-error flag.
comparisonMatrix.baselineRetention: Old known40 C7 seven C and six criticals remain their separate DEV reference. New cases do not create a36/64 or72/80 acceptance threshold. Compare any later intervention with the same80 plus retained old40 evidence under its proper generation receipt.
comparisonMatrix.uncertainty: One model/seed and small synthetic DEV sample; publish exact denominators and IDs. No competitive global, human or unseen-family claim.

conditionalReadout: If canonical and paraphrased questions differ with unchanged fact order and same target, the probe supports a local wording-sensitivity description; inspect B and relation errors before choosing wording augmentation.
If fact order changes answers to balanced targets while question is fixed, inspect positional or referent errors separately; a wording-only explanation is insufficient.
If ideal history succeeds while actual history fails after erroneous previous replies, the probe supports conditional history sensitivity, not unassisted comprehension or acceptance.
If both history branches and wordings are incoherent, do not declare a wording repair proven; linguistic form and relation grounding remain separate unresolved problems.
decisionBeforeOneIntervention.trainingRule: Root chooses one bounded intervention only after actual results and data-quality audit. Preserve original C7, prior records and folds. Never use these cases, ideal replies, constraints, prompt/fact hashes or personal chat as TRAIN.

freeze: Freeze cases.json, ideal-history.json, protocol.json and hash-only-exclusion.json plus SHA receipt before first new case output; then do not edit them. Model registration, raw outputs and reviews go in separate files.
